loss: mean squared error in coordinate-normalized fixed-D eta
sampling: same unified sample-uniform minibatch permutation; no reweighting or oversampling
normalization: 214-D input fitted on exact training split only; eta coordinates affine-normalized using frozen domain envelope
eta_output: linear normalized eta, transparently clipped to [0,1] only at deployment
selection_rule: validation-only minimax multiplicative regret on startup/warm eta-L2 Pareto frontier; ties use all-validation eta L2 then earlier epoch
